findings.claim: The HTML drill-down's Inputs table shows only each input's label and value. It leaves out the 'lines' list that derived_inputs attaches to an input: the lines in each M4 quarter, the lines in M15/M16/M26's numerator, and M9's operating group versus its sent-back group. /api/lines carries those lists but the page the underwriter clicks to does not, so on the page the underwriter cannot tell which of the listed lines make up each input.
findings.repro: Import tests/test_drilldown.py's _months_statement() and open /lines?figure=M4 with the token. The Inputs rows say 'Earliest quarter ... £3,000.00' and 'Latest quarter ... £4,801.00' and name no lines. /api/lines?figure=M4 gives inputs[0].lines and inputs[1].lines.
